title: BUT AREN'T INCINERATORS POLLUTING AND DANGEROUS? WHAT GUARANTEES ARE THERE FOR THE HEALTH OF THOSE WHO LIVE NEAR YOU?
answer: Incinerators, like everything else, are dangerous if used outside the rules. But this is not the case of GIDA that acts in full compliance with Italian and European standards. We directly control emissions 24 hours a day and are then subject to "surprise" inspections by ARPAT, which reports in public documents on the outcome of its audits. In addition, GIDA data are periodically transmitted to the control bodies and available on the website of the Province of Prato.
